name: Daventry Gateway Park
notes: Modern big-box on the M1/A5 corridor near existing Daventry operations. Strong labour pool but competes with several 3PLs for agency staff. Planning permission in place; highest rent of the three.
incentives: Enterprise zone business rates relief (3 years); local authority recruitment grant of about 1,500 GBP per new hire.

name: Corby Enterprise Park
notes: Cheaper rent and a ready-built unit, but thinner labour supply and A14/A43 congestion on the way to the M1. Planning needs a change-of-use variation.
incentives: Enterprise zone business rates relief (5 years); capital grant up to 250,000 GBP for 150 or more jobs.

name: Doncaster iPort
notes: Rail-served site near the M18/A1(M) with good northern coverage. High planning risk: the green-belt boundary is contested and a judicial review is pending. Competes with two large retailers for labour.
incentives: Freeport customs and tax benefits; skills fund contribution towards training.

name: Coventry Gateway Business Park
notes: Partner-led option, dropped earlier: too small for the volume.
removed_reason: Lower capacity than Daventry, higher long-term cost.
